# 【Post-Talk💬】LOVE MISSION♡

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID discussed her new song 'Love Mission,' detailing its unexpected dance difficulty and comparing it to previous works.
- She shared anecdotes including accidentally going live late, an accidental early song release, and her unique mind-control lore.
- Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID teased an upcoming, even more challenging original song and a long-term 'Fizzy' project.
- She humorously revealed keeping a hair dryer next to her PC for cleaning and discussed various tech and payment-related anecdotes.
- Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID reflected on her busy two years in Japan and outlined new health management goals including sleep and diet improvements.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:00:07](#t=00:00:07) Forgot to Go Live**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID realized she was talking to herself for three minutes, having forgotten to press the 'live' button for the stream.
- **[⏱️ 00:06:58](#t=00:06:58) 'Love Mission' Dance Difficulty**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID elaborated on the unexpected difficulty of the 'Love Mission' dance, stating it's harder than 'Break It Down' due to intricate hand movements and stamina requirements, even challenging her dance teacher.
- **[⏱️ 00:15:01](#t=00:15:01) Early Song Release Clarification**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID clarified that her new song 'Love Mission' was accidentally released digitally a day before its music video premiere due to miscommunication, rather than after the MV as planned.
- **[⏱️ 00:20:20](#t=00:20:20) Mind Control Lore Explained**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID discussed the lyrics of her song 'Love Mission,' particularly the 'ETA' line, and jokingly delved into her lore of mind control, asserting she hacks minds to make people support her.
- **[⏱️ 00:35:40](#t=00:35:40) English Rap Lyrics Recited**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID recited the English translation of the rap part from her song 'Love Mission,' featuring themes of 'access denied,' 'hacking,' 'love as data,' and being a 'navigator.'
- **[⏱️ 00:46:10](#t=00:46:10) Hair Dryer by PC for Dust**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID revealed the fun fact that she keeps a hair dryer next to her PC, primarily to blow dust out of the computer, humorously sparking a debate about PC cleaning.
- **[⏱️ 01:02:50](#t=01:02:50) Barcode Payment Joke**: Inspired by chat comments, Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID and chat joked about tattooing a barcode or QR code on the back of one's head for easy payment, likening it to Agent 47 and PayPay for convenient transactions.
- **[⏱️ 01:08:40](#t=01:08:40) Health Management Goals**: Prompted by her manager, Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID outlined her new health management plans, including fixing her sleep schedule, cleaning her room, eating healthier (excluding vegetables), drinking more water, and scheduling overdue health checkups.

## ⏱️ Timeline Breakdown
- **[⏱️ 00:00:07](#t=00:00:07) Love Mission Overview**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID began the segment by realizing she had been talking to herself for three minutes, having forgotten to press the 'live' button. She then dove into discussing her new song, 'Love Mission,' and its music video, describing it as a lovey-dovey J-pop track that contrasts with her previous works. She shared an anecdote about almost spilling matcha. Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID dedicated time to reading chat reactions to the music video, expressing gratitude for gifts and acknowledging appreciation for the rap part. A significant portion of the discussion focused on the surprising difficulty of the 'Love Mission' dance, which she claims is harder than 'Break It Down,' particularly due to intricate hand movements and stamina demands, recounting her dance teacher's exhaustion. She expressed satisfaction with the effort put into the song and promotion, then teased her next original song, promising it will be 'completely different' and potentially two to three times harder to dance than 'Break It Down.' Finally, Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID confirmed the appearance of the new VIZY logo at the end of the MV and mentioned designing a t-shirt with a cat theme.
- **[⏱️ 00:15:01](#t=00:15:01) Early Release & Fan Chant**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID discussed the accidental early digital release of her new song, 'Love Mission,' due to a miscommunication, expressing gratitude for the early support. She shared details about the song's lyrics, including the 'ETA' line, and humorously expanded on her mind-control lore, asserting she hacks minds to make people support her. Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID also introduced a self-made, easy-to-follow fan chant guide for 'Love Mission,' encouraging fans to learn it and engaging in a playful exchange about using the 'CODE Love' chant as a greeting for 'Zekky days'.
- **[⏱️ 00:30:01](#t=00:30:01) Pronunciation & 'Fizzy'**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID engaged with chat, playfully discussing misspellings and misinterpretations of words like 'LOVE' as 'Fish.' She then talked about her song 'Love Mission,' clarifying her unique pronunciation of 'baku baku' as 'babu babu' and its meaning as baby talk. Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID revealed she doesn't have direct access to some social media accounts, with her staff handling posts, and briefly mentioned her two-year cycle for Twitch streams. A significant part of the segment focused on Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID reciting the English translation of the rap section from 'Love Mission,' which involves themes of data, hacking, and navigation. Towards the end, Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID expressed her dedication to learning the rap part for live performances and shared details about an upcoming project called 'Fizzy,' for which she has been working unpaid for months, anticipating it will be a rewarding experience for her and her audience.
- **[⏱️ 00:45:07](#t=00:45:07) PC Cleaning & Captions**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID engaged with chat, discussing the creative Korean subtitles for a music video before revealing her unusual habit of keeping a hair dryer next to her PC, which sparked a humorous debate about PC cleaning frequency and methods, including a joke about washing machines. She then shared a personal anecdote about hair dryers and analyzed the tonal shift in a specific part of a song. The segment concluded with Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID troubleshooting and reassuring viewers about caption functionality issues.
- **[⏱️ 01:00:00](#t=01:00:00) Advanced Dryer & Health**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID elaborated on the advanced features of her hair dryer, which can sense scalp proximity and adjust heat, leading to significantly faster drying times. She highly recommended it as a gift idea. This led to a humorous discussion about payment methods, sparked by a chat comment about Agent 47, evolving into a joke about tattooing QR codes on the back of one's head for convenient transactions. Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID then shared an amusing anecdote about someone accidentally revealing their 'Oshi' (favorite VTuber) on screen during a payment attempt. Transitioning to personal reflections, she discussed her two years living in Japan, describing it as her busiest period yet, filled with numerous projects. Finally, she outlined her renewed commitment to health management, including fixing her sleep schedule, improving her diet (though playfully excluding vegetables), increasing water intake, and scheduling long-overdue health checkups, noting an upcoming studio visit.
- **[⏱️ 01:15:00](#t=01:15:00) Viewer Thanks & TV Show**: Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID began by reacting to a viewer's comment about getting their wallet stolen, linking it to a 'gong premiere' (song premiere) that the viewer was happy to be back for. She then thanked her audience for watching, commenting, and sharing her song, promising to release more music. Later, she discussed a TV series she's been watching called 'The Irrational,' which features an applied psychology professor solving crimes. The segment concluded with Vestia Zeta Ch. hololive-ID expressing surprise that viewers still remember 'Squeaky' after three months.
